docs/LLD/persistence.md section 3 prints USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id')::uuid). The one-argument form RAISES when the setting is absent, which contradicts section 9 of the same document ('zero rows, not an error, plus an alarm') and S0.5.7 acceptance 3. Implemented as NULLIF(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid. The doc needs amending.
